# Focus Group Skills

> Six Claude Code / Cursor skills built for Salesforce sales teams: a
> multi-persona review panel, a runtime-adaptive doc harvester, a multi-model
> cross-AI audit, a bidirectional anonymizer that scrubs customer data before
> any external LLM call, a Slack-MCP-sourced customer-context profiler, and
> a local-only improvement coach that sharpens the panel report (or any
> draft) before the user sends it on.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). It gives
AI systems a fast, link-rich summary of the focus-group-skill repository
so they can reference it accurately.

## What's in this repository

- A public, template-able collection of Claude Code skills under
  `.claude/skills/` and Cursor command shims under `.cursor/commands/`.
- Designed for Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Industry Specialists,
  Enterprise / Technical Architects, Business Value Consultants, and Lead
  Engagement / SDR coaches working with Salesforce CRM + Agentforce and
  the broader Salesforce + Slack product family.
- Aggressive privacy posture: every prompt that reaches an external LLM
  passes through `/anonymize` first; the local map.json never leaves the
  laptop; no telemetry.

## The six skills

### /focus-group — multi-persona review panel
- Path: `.claude/skills/focus-group/SKILL.md`
- 177 persona files across 9 lens groupings (5 Generic sub-families + Salesforce-Sales + Salesforce-Customer + Salesforce-Partner + Industry-specific). Public sector ships 13 personas (state/local + federal/DoD + international); most other packs ship 5–8 to cover the load-bearing seats per sub-vertical.
- 13 product packs + 19 industry packs + generic bypass.
- Default product pack: salesforce-crm-agentforce. Default panel size: 5.
- 12-step pipeline (role gate at Step 1, customer-grounding gate at Step 4
  with profile-by-name / by culture & size / skip, current-customer fork
  with sf / Salesforce MCP / Slack consent menu).
- Stage A (Claude aggregate) → Stage B (different model consolidate) →
  Stage C (merge + accuracy score + citations).

### /download — runtime-adaptive doc harvester
- Path: `.claude/skills/download/SKILL.md`
- Runtime chain: Python+Playwright → Node+Playwright/Puppeteer →
  PowerShell+Edge → Chrome headless → curl/wget.
- Salesforce-aware search engines (help.salesforce.com, Trailhead,
  architect.salesforce.com, developer.salesforce.com).
- LinkedIn URLs short-circuit to a local-files workaround.

### /cross-ai-review — multi-model audit
- Path: `.claude/skills/cross-ai-review/SKILL.md`
- Detects claude, codex, gemini, opencode CLIs.
- Multi-Claude fallback: when only `claude` is installed, runs Opus +
  Sonnet in parallel.
- Accuracy score (0–100); --require-citations strict mode caps at 70.

### /anonymize — bidirectional placeholder safety layer
- Path: `.claude/skills/anonymize/SKILL.md`
- Bidirectional placeholders: {{COMPANY_1}}, {{PERSON_2_ROLE=CISO}}, etc.
- Aggressive-by-default: when in doubt, scrub.
- Four runtimes: Python (full), Node.js (full), PowerShell (degraded),
  POSIX shell (degraded). Same map.json format across all four.
- Local map.json is git-ignored and never leaves the laptop.

### /slackbot — anonymized Slack-sourced customer context
- Path: `.claude/skills/slackbot/SKILL.md`
- Queries via the Slack MCP server.
- Member-only scope (never DMs, never channels the user isn't in).
- Routes the raw profile through /anonymize before any model sees it.
